correction.detail: A shared intentMacCacheKey helper returns `${stableLocalOwnerKey}\0intent-mac-v1`. intentMacKey uses that exact suffixed key for lookup and population, and retireWorkspace now deletes the same key. Previously retirement deleted the bare stableLocalOwnerKey and left the private HMAC CryptoKey cached. Durable local-AEAD storage rows and intentional durable key reload behavior remain unchanged.
correction.impactBoundary: This closes the reachable private-key-cache retirement defect in volatile workspace custody. Existing workspace-grant checks still reject stale operations; the source review found no demonstrated cross-owner signing bypass or public raw-key getter.

regression.testName: retires volatile intent-MAC custody on workspace lock without evicting another workspace key
regression.detail: Uses indexedDB:null, creates an intent commitment under a workspace grant, retires that grant, confirms stale use is rejected, and regrants the same stable scope with a new epoch. The next commitment differs, showing a fresh volatile HMAC key; a separate workspace commitment remains unchanged.
